paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the gradient norm of the reward model during training, as part of the RLHF workflow from reward modeling to online RLHF. The x-axis, labeled “Training Step,” spans from 0 to 7000 in linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 1000. The y-axis, labeled “Gradient Norm,” ranges from 0 to 40, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines at intervals of 5. A single blue solid line with no markers represents the “Gradient Norm of Reward Model.” At training step 0, the gradient norm begins near 40, then rapidly drops to approximately 10 by step 500. From step 500 to 7000, the gradient norm fluctuates between roughly 5 and 10, with occasional spikes reaching up to 14 (e.g., near steps 2800, 4100, and 5800), but generally remains low and stable. The plot includes a legend in the upper right corner identifying the blue line.
